title: Thyroid Carcinoma
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS

blocks.text: Thyroid cancer is the most common endocrine malignancy in Tanzania. Histological types are medullary, anaplastic, and well- differentiated thyroid cancer. Most of these cases are differentiated thyroid cancer, the commonest being the follicular subtype, followed by the papillary subtype. Rare ones are Hurthle cell, a follicular variant of papillary thyroid carcinoma, tall cell, columnar, solid, and clear cell. Females are mostly affected, the male-to-female ratio being 3:1. Follicular cells take up iodide ions, including radioactive iodine (RAI).
